Row.Text: From the shelter of the cothon, ships prepare for their expeditions. Some are loaded with fine pottery, grain, and other goods to be exchanged for gold and ivory. Others carry soldiers ready to profit by other means. Each will return home, to the center of the world - Carthage. Open the cothon gates, and let returning fleets shower the city in prosperity.
The children of Tyre come from afar to claim their destiny. From the center of the world, they will command an empire that knows no equal.
Carthage can purchase Water Buildings in all their Towns. This means they can get both Buildings for their Punic Port Unique Quarter, increasing their Resource Capacity for the rest of the game.
